#!/bin/bash
# Load-race reproduction: the named tests, each repeated, on N workers with K
# CPU burners beside them. Usage:
#   repro-load.sh <tree> <out.json> <repeat> <burners> <file:line>...
# Runs as its own unit (systemd-run --user --unit …); the burners die with it.
set -u
TREE=$1; OUT=$2; REPEAT=$3; BURN=$4; shift 4
cd "$TREE/lcnc-webui" || exit 2
# the ONE heavy lock of the gates, perf_matrix and the native stage (Codex R269)
LOCK=${LCNC_HEAVY_LOCK:-$HOME/claude-work/live-tier/heavy.lock}
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOCK")"
exec 9>>"$LOCK"
flock -w 14400 9 || { echo "heavy lock held: $(cat "$LOCK")" >&2; exit 4; }
: > "$LOCK"; echo "repro-load (pid $$, since $(date -Is))" >> "$LOCK"
executed: none; only the flock mechanism was reproduced on an own temporary lock with the load body replaced by printf
